notes.title: Major Alpha Release and First Developer Stream
notes.notes:
Big changes in the latest alpha release! This build features the debut of the completely reworked UI system with new tooltip and help features. Features seeing major updates in this release include the enemy and player status windows, the action log, the card well, the pause menu, and the main menu. Development has now begun on the single player campaign mode and is scheduled to be included in the next major release. With this current release we will be opening up more alpha tester spots and we need your help! Your feedback will help us catch bugs and refine development, keeping us on track for our Early Access release in a few months.


Here’s a peek at some of the new UI updates just released:

[hr][/hr]
The Ars Victor community will be heavily involved in this game. Beginning this Saturday, November 28th at 11AM PST, we’re going to be bringing you weekly broadcasts featuring developer-led showcases of the latest development builds, introducing new features, mechanics, and artwork. Our first installment of the series will feature the creators of Ars Victor, Mike Bott and Steve DeBaun. Other developers will be on hand to provide commentary and answer your questions about the game. Just click on our store page to watch the broadcast and join the chat. We look forward to hearing from you!


Would you like to know more? Leave a question or your feedback for us on the Discussions page or join our Discord server and just say hi. We’re also streaming games a few times a week on our Twitch channel. Check us out!

Discord: https://discord.gg/waUpeE9
Twitch: https://twitch.tv/tripwestgames
